feeds.title: New Humanist Blog
feeds.description: New Humanist is the London based magazine of the Rationalist Association, promoting reason, debate and free thought since 1885. In addition, the New Humanist website features daily updates and a lively weblog.

feeds.title: Ex-Muslims
feeds.description: We, non-believers, atheists, and ex-Muslims, are establishing or joining the Council of Ex-Muslims of Britain to insist that no one is pigeonholed as Muslims with culturally relative rights nor deemed to be represented by regressive Islamic organizations and 'Muslim community leaders'.

feeds.title: Patheos
feeds.description: The Freethinker was one of the world's longest-running atheist journal. The Freethinker is an anti-Christian organ, and must, therefore, be chiefly aggressive. It will wage a relentless war against superstition in general, and against Christian superstition in particular.

feeds.title: Dorset Humanists
feeds.description: Dorset Humanists is a welcoming group for humanists, atheists, and agnostics who seek to live ethical and fulfilling lives based on reason and humanity.
